hook: A display that holds its image for months, unplugged

beats.say: Researchers in Australia built a reflective display from antimony selenide that keeps its image for months without any power.
Ordinary screens need constant power to hold a picture, but this phase-change material is rearranged at the atomic level and stays put.
Erasing it means heating the film to around 200 degrees Celsius uniformly, letting the atoms move and find new positions.
